slides.headline: Reportedly A Queen's Order, 44 Years Late

slides.text: Breguet received the order from an officer of the Queen's Guard.
No client is named. The queen link is oral tradition.
Interruptions followed. She was guillotined on 16 October 1793, never seeing it.
Antoine-Louis Breguet completed it after numerous interruptions.
British collector Sir Spencer Brunton bought it in 1887.
Taken from a Jerusalem museum, April 1983. Found 2007.
